body.name: Rank-adaptive spectral handle
body.construction: Use cross-fitted spectral projectors for \(H(X)\), select \(\lambda_n\) by a Lepski-type stability comparison across adjacent eigenspaces, preserve \(A^{\prime}b=\omega\) by affine projection, and combine directional delta-method critical values across the retained rank candidates to target a confidence interval for \(\tau_{\omega}\).
